usage: agentware prefer scan-queue [-h] [--sid SID] [--cwd CWD]
                                   [--prompts PROMPTS]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --sid SID          the current session id (queue is scoped/watermarked per
                     session)
  --cwd CWD          fallback checkout dir when a record omits cwd
  --prompts PROMPTS  prompts.log path (default: <kdir>/logs/prompts.log;
                     overridable for tests)
